visualReview.method: Viewed each of the three side-by-side comparisons and each overlay individually at 1440x900 concept scale.
matched: White shell, crimson active states, Mulish type, five role tabs and 262px sources rail.
Live source card, exact highlighted passage, cursor, recorded plan and fact connector.
Completed numbered nodes, local evidence/law chain and yellow cited source preview.
Later-case vertical spine, green source/checklist/result cards and qualified-review notice.

deliberate.difference: Recorded heating examples, sources, questions and evidence replace the concept illustrations. The original CasePath wordmark is retained; unsupported settings/reply/write controls stay absent.
deliberate.reason: Recorded data and functioning controls only; approved handoff scope.

deliberate.difference: Four received sources, intake/context labels, recorded header fields only, a single recorded fact card in this frame, question-specific Checking/Decide wording and automated-role legend.
deliberate.reason: Actual record cardinality and missing header fields; requested cold-viewer clarity. Active tab follows the recorded operation.

deliberate.difference: Six linear completed steps occupy one row. The chain and source preview rise into the unused fork space. Missing-evidence columns and Edit decision are absent; the document readiness sentence is limited to this assessment.
deliberate.reason: All nine recorded reference graphs are linear; no alternate branch, editable decision or active document gap exists. No synthetic structure or readiness claim is invented.

deliberate.difference: Six recorded questions, no BEFORE/NOW or expert-reviewed claim. Cards show the later case passage, the named earlier case and its three checklist items, recorded automated checks, and the later case result link.
deliberate.reason: Only automated checklist reuse is recorded; human memory editing requires separate authority. The source and outcome are from the later case.

deliberate.difference: Demo transport and fictional-case labels stay visible; source text keeps recorded spelling and line wrapping. Desktop scope only.
deliberate.reason: Honest read-only replay and source integrity. Mobile retains the existing claim view.
